hangzhou-15.bio: Two-site museum in the Longjing hills with permanent exhibitions on Chinese tea culture and tea production.
hangzhou-15.notes: Free entry reported only by third-party travel sites (Ctrip, westchinago.com/china-national-tea-museum); official site has no fee page in the cached text. Shuangfeng (Longjing Rd 88) and Longjing (Wengjiashan 268) sites. Reservation need unverified.

hangzhou-33.bio: Restored Ming-era academy on the slope of Phoenix Hill with lecture halls, Confucian statue and cliff carvings.
hangzhou-33.ticket_note: Managed by West Lake Scenic Area Phoenix Hill office; no dedicated official site found.
hangzhou-33.notes: 10 CNY from a 2020 Hangzhou Net article; may be outdated or now free: unverified. Address Wansongling Rd 81, Shangcheng.

huzhou-8.bio: Merchant mansion in Nanxun with a Chinese courtyard in front and a European-style villa with stained glass behind.
huzhou-8.ticket_note: No official site found; Nanxun town runs it with other sights.
huzhou-8.notes: 20 CNY is Ctrip's starting price. A travel blog mentions a ~75 CNY combined ticket for Nanxun's paid sights (unverified).

liangshanbo-butterfly-temple.bio: Park in Ningbo's western suburbs built around Liangshanbo Temple, the Butterfly Lovers tomb and a butterfly sculpture.
liangshanbo-butterfly-temple.ticket_note: No official site found; official ticket line is 0574-88447238 (Ctrip).
liangshanbo-butterfly-temple.notes: 30 CNY from the Zhejiang Dept of Culture and Tourism listing (2019, seen via search snippet only; page fetch failed), possibly outdated. English Wikipedia 'Liangzhu Culture Park' is a different place (Hangzhou).

jiangshan-2.bio: Old trading town on the Xianxia Ancient Road at the Zhejiang, Jiangxi and Fujian border, with a Qing-era street.
jiangshan-2.ticket_note: Official site (www.28du.com, listed on zh Wikipedia) returned an empty page to the fetcher; check in a real browser.
jiangshan-2.notes: Ticketed (ticket office past Zhupo Bridge; paid sights along Xunli Street; ticket reportedly valid a year) but PRICE UNVERIFIED: no number found. Needs costMin/costMax before applying. Ctrip and zh Wikipedia list it as a 5A scenic area.

taizhou-4.bio: Fonte theme park on Taizhou Bay with rides, shows and a night programme built on animation and adventure themes.
taizhou-4.notes: Operator (Fangte/华强方特) homepage lists 台州方特•狂野大陆 but has no deep page for it; use the homepage. 195 CNY is Qunar's adult standard from-price (Ctrip shows 150 from, a discounted price); official price unverified.
